{{Quote|The Warhound founded our favorite mercenary company. Seventy years old and sealed in a battle suit&hellip; He's commandeered dreadnaughts, and he's our second-biggest problem.|[[Katha Niar]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Warhound''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and the founder of the [[InterStellar Regulators]]. By the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Warhound was seventy years old and sealed in a [[Armor/Legends|battle suit]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Imperial forces in the [[Cartel mining mesa]] on [[Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />
